title: Add Source - Upload PDF File Successfully
description: Verify that users can upload a PDF file via the Add Source modal and it appears correctly in the Sources panel.

steps.description: Open the Add Source modal
Select the Upload Files tab
Upload a valid PDF file
Check that the uploaded PDF appears in the Sources panel list
Verify that the source can be previewed correctly

title: Add Source - Enter Valid URL
description: Verify that users can add a source by entering a valid URL and that it appears in the Sources panel.

steps.description: Open the Add Source modal
Switch to the Add URL tab
Input a valid URL
Submit the URL
Verify the new source is listed in the Sources panel
Preview the URL content from Sources panel

title: Add Source - Create Manual Note
description: Verify manual note creation via Add Source modal with validation and display in Sources panel.

steps.description: Open Add Source modal
Switch to Create Note tab
Enter valid note content and title
Submit the note
Note appears in Sources panel
Note content is previewable

title: Add Source - Input Validation and Error Handling
description: Verify that invalid inputs in Add Source modal trigger correct validation messages and prevent submission.

steps.description: Open Add Source modal
Try to upload unsupported file type
Validation error is displayed
Try to enter invalid URL format
Validation error is displayed
Try to submit empty manual note
Validation error is displayed and submission is blocked

title: Sources Panel - Search Functionality
description: Verify that searching sources in the Sources panel filters the list accordingly with responsiveness.

steps.description: Populate Sources panel with a large list of sources
Enter search query in Sources panel search bar
Sources list updates to show matching entries only
No UI freezes or lag during search

title: Sources Panel - Multi-Select and Scope Setting for Chat
description: Verify selecting multiple sources filters the content scope accessible to the AI chat assistant accordingly.

steps.description: Select multiple sources in Sources panel
Selected sources are indicated as active scope
Send question in Chat panel
AI chat responses reflect only selected sources contents

title: Sources Panel - Rename and Delete Source
description: Verify renaming sources updates their names persistently, and deleting sources removes them properly.

steps.description: Rename an existing source in Sources panel
New name is reflected immediately and persists on refresh
Delete a source from Sources panel
Source is removed from list and no longer accessible

title: Chat Panel - Streaming AI Responses with Clickable Citations
description: Verify chat panel displays AI Tutor responses streaming progressively including clickable citations that open correct source excerpts with highlighting.

steps.description: Enter a question in Chat panel
AI response streams progressively in chat thread
Citations appear as clickable links within response
Click a citation link
Corresponding source excerpt opens with correct highlight

title: Chat Panel - Long Chat History Performance and Virtualization
description: Verify chat panel performs smoothly with hundreds of messages using virtualization and lazy loading.

steps.description: Load chat history with over 200 messages
Chat panel scrolls and responds without lag
Send new message to AI chat
New message and response append smoothly

title: Study Tools Panel - Generate Flashcards from Selected Sources
description: Verify flashcard generation from selected sources works correctly and flashcards are added to the Study Tools panel.

steps.description: Select sources in Sources panel
Switch to Flashcards tab in Study Tools panel
Generate flashcards from selected sources
Flashcards are created and displayed

title: Study Tools Panel - Edit and Study Flashcards with Grading and Session Summary
description: Verify editing flashcards, studying with grading, and displaying session summaries function as expected.

steps.description: Edit content of an existing flashcard
Changes are saved and reflected immediately
Enter study mode for flashcards
Grade flashcard responses
Session summary with grades and statistics is displayed correctly

title: Study Tools Panel - Generate and Take MCQ Quizzes
description: Verify quizzes are generated with configurable number and difficulty of questions, and taking quizzes shows results with explanations and citations.

steps.description: Select sources for quiz content
Switch to Quizzes tab
Configure number of questions and difficulty
Generate quiz
MCQ quiz appears with expected questions
Complete the quiz
Display quiz results with explanations and citations

title: Study Tools Panel - Mini-Game Term-Definition Matching
description: Verify mini-game runs properly with correct term-definition content, scoring, and the ability to replay.

steps.description: Select sources to supply mini-game content
Switch to Mini-game tab
Start mini-game
Mini-game loads terms and definitions correctly
Complete a game session
Score is calculated and displayed correctly
Use replay function to restart the mini-game
Game restarts and resets state properly

title: UI - Panel Resizing Persistence Across Sessions
description: Verify that resizing the three panels on desktop persists correctly on refresh and new sessions.

steps.description: Resize Sources, Chat, and Study Tools panels using drag handles
Panel sizes update live during the resize
Reload the application
Panel sizes persist to last saved sizes

title: UI - Responsive Drawer Behavior on Mobile/Tablet
description: Verify that on mobile and tablet devices, panels collapse into drawers and user can toggle them properly.

steps.description: Open application in mobile or tablet viewport
Panels collapse to drawers
Toggle each drawer open and close
Drawers open and close smoothly without layout issues

title: UI - Fullscreen Toggle for Study Tools Panel
description: Verify Study Tools panel fullscreen toggle overlays it properly and exits returning to previous layout preserving state.

steps.description: Click fullscreen toggle button on Study Tools panel
Study Tools panel occupies fullscreen overlay
Exit fullscreen mode
Panel returns to previous size and state is preserved

title: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation and Focus Management
description: Verify full keyboard operability including tab navigation, arrow keys where applicable, and focus visible on interactive elements.

steps.description: Navigate through the entire workspace using keyboard only
Focus moves sequentially and visibly across all interactive components
Use keyboard to interact with Add Source modal controls
Inputs and buttons are operable and focus trapped inside modals

title: Accessibility - ARIA Roles and Modal Focus Trapping
description: Verify ARIA roles are present and modals trap focus while open and release on close including ESC key handling.

steps.description: Open Add Source modal
Modal has correct ARIA roles and labels
Press tab key repeatedly to attempt leaving modal
Focus does not escape modal while open
Press ESC key
Modal closes and focus returns to previously focused element

title: Performance - Time to First AI Chat Answer Under 2 Minutes
description: Verify that after submitting a question, the first AI chat response arrives within 2 minutes maximum.

steps.description: Enter and submit question in Chat panel
First partial AI response arrives within 2 minutes

title: Performance - Smooth Experience with Hundreds of Sources
description: Verify that the Sources panel performs smoothly with hundreds of sources loaded using virtualization and lazy loading.

steps.description: Load 500+ sources in Sources panel
Sources panel scrolls smoothly without lag or UI freezes
Use search and multi-select on large source list
UI remains responsive and stable

title: Analytics - Track Key User Interactions
description: Verify analytics events for source_added, chat_sent, flashcards_generated, quiz_completed, and game_completed are correctly captured and reported.

steps.description: Add a new source
Event 'source_added' is sent
Send a chat message
Event 'chat_sent' is sent
Generate flashcards
Event 'flashcards_generated' is sent
Complete a quiz
Event 'quiz_completed' is sent
Complete mini-game
Event 'game_completed' is sent

title: Security - Input Validation and Sanitization of Sources and Content
description: Verify that all inputs for sources and user-created content are validated and sanitized to prevent injection or rendering vulnerabilities.

steps.description: Attempt to add source with malicious script tags or malformed input
Input is sanitized and no scripts are executed
Render source content with special characters
Content is safely rendered without XSS or injection issues
